notes.title: Bonus Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Made some adjustments to the creature's AI, to make it more consistent
[*]Fixed an issue where the creature couldn't move, despite being in the dark
[*]Fixed an issue with the creature's navmesh, which allowed the player to occasionally push it around
[/list]

If you find any bugs, please let me know in the discussions! I try my best to playtest, but I'm only a one person dev team, so I can't catch everything, thank you for the support!

notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added a new rare event, where your match can be blown out (like in the trailer)
[*]The creature now has a second spawn location, which it will use if the player is too close to its normal spawn location
[*]The creature will now always run away from the player when transitioning into its hiding state, its move speed when looking for a hiding spot has also been increased
[*]Increased the duration of the chase state, and the hiding state
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the match to be lit for longer than anticipated
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug with the keypad, causing multiple inputs to be registered in a single click
